title: Sir Roderic Lightbearer — Reference Plate
source_reconciliation: Use the attached images of Sir Roderic Lightbearer as the definitive source for this character's identity — face, hair, build, age, and his signature armor, heraldry, and gear. Preserve his face and likeness faithfully. Do not restyle the face toward a different, older, or model-handsome appearance that drifts from his reference.
identity_lock: A young, fair-skinned knight with tousled blond hair and clean or lightly-stubbled features; full plate armor of polished silver-steel covered in fine gold filigree scrollwork, with a gold cross on the breastplate; a deep heraldic-blue cloak/surcoat; a tall blue kite shield bearing a gold rampant lion; an ornate cross-hilted longsword. Bright, clean, knightly arms — this is correct for him. He may rest his sword point-down and hold his shield at his side.

palette: warm rich gold filigree detailing (rich, not neon or glowing)
deep heraldic blue cloak and shield field
gold rampant lion on the blue shield
house_style_overrides.palette_note: Replaces the default muted WORLD_PALETTE with this canonical bright palette; do NOT mute, tarnish, or desaturate him into the earthy world palette — his brightness is canonical identity.
house_style_overrides.signature_items: Gold-filigreed plate, blue kite shield with gold rampant lion, ornate cross-hilted longsword — rendered as real worked metal with weight and faint honest wear, not mirror gloss or neon/glowing gold.
